title.value: Comparative Study of Large Language Model Architectures on Frontier
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper, detailing the nature of the research conducted.
title.quote: Comparative Study of Large Language Model Architectures on Frontier

analysis.description: This paper presents a comparative study of two prominent open-sourced GPT architectures, GPT-NeoX and LLaMA, leveraging computational power on Frontier, an Exascale supercomputer, for a materials science text corpus. The study analyzes training and downstream performance, computational efficiency, and proposes a method for architecture design. Additionally, it introduces a new foundation model for materials science called MatGPT.

type.justification: The study involves empirical evaluation and comparison of GPT-NeoX and LLaMA architectures in terms of their training and downstream performance, using computational resources.
type.quote: Here we will study the performance and optimization of the popular training frameworks on Frontier — the first Exascale supercomputer which is equipped with AMD GPUs.

name.value: Natural Language Processing in Materials Science
name.justification: The paper focuses on the use of language models for understanding and applying materials science data, which falls under the application of NLP methods in the field of materials science.
name.quote: To our knowledge, these pre-trained models represent the largest available for materials science. Our findings provide practical guidance for building LLMs on HPC platforms.

name.justification: The paper discusses and compares large language models such as GPT-NeoX and LLaMA.
name.quote: Among these, the Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) has emerged as the dominant architecture, spawning numerous variants.

name.justification: The GPT-NeoX architecture is a primary subject of study in the paper, being one of the two models compared in terms of performance.
name.quote: Here we meticulously examine two prominent open-sourced GPT architectures, GPT-NeoX and LLaMA, leveraging the computational power of Frontier.

is_contributed.justification: GPT-NeoX is an existing model and is not newly contributed in this research but is used for comparison in the study.
is_contributed.quote: Following the evolutionary tree of LLM architecture, [...] GPT-NeoX and LLaMA are among the most popular open-source variants of GPT-3.

is_executed.justification: The model was executed and evaluated using the Frontier supercomputer as described in the study.
is_executed.quote: Here we will study the performance and optimization of the popular training frameworks on Frontier — the first Exascale supercomputer which is equipped with AMD GPUs.

is_compared.justification: GPT-NeoX is compared with LLaMA in terms of training and downstream performance.
is_compared.quote: We comparatively studied two mainstream GPT architecture variants, i.e., GPT-NeoX and LLaMA, and evaluated their end-to-end pre-training recipes.
